cutoff_window.policy: Only public sources with a visible date strictly inside this two-day window qualify. A source with only a date on the lower-boundary calendar day is excluded because its publication time cannot be shown to be inside the window.

federation_boundary.local_scope: AI-assisted-development practice: workflow controls, verification, governance, context, and adoption. Product and provider facts are retained only as routing notes or as evidence for a local practice implication.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Cisco introduced Agentic FAITH, an extension of its evaluation framework for multi-step, tool-using agent tasks. Its VulnLoc benchmark supplies a repository snapshot and vulnerability class, scores both vulnerable-file identification and correct no-vulnerability conclusions on patched code, uses a read-only repository environment, and records task completion distinctly from a missing submission or execution failure. The framework saves conversation history, tool calls and responses, submitted answers, execution errors, and termination reasons; benchmark definitions can make prompts, turn limits, tool budgets, and timeouts explicit.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Evaluation harnesses should assess both detection and correct abstention after a fix, use least-privilege test environments, and preserve run traces, budgets, and terminal states. Scores without these execution conditions cannot distinguish a sound negative result from an incomplete or failed run.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: Route Cisco and named framework or benchmark background to the upstream AI wiki. If ingested locally, retain only the downstream evaluation-harness pattern: read-only execution, positive and negative cases, explicit budgets, checkpointing, and trace-backed outcomes.

qualifying_updates.source_title: What specification is your AI coding agent actually implementing?
qualifying_updates.source_type: practitioner-authored Sogeti research blog; experience and cited benchmark figures require source-specific corroboration during ingest
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The author describes a coding-agent modernization attempt in which generated transformations compiled but implemented unsupported interpretations when legacy behavior, business rules, mappings, and source data conflicted. The proposed practice is to expose a reviewable chain from distributed evidence through interpretation and specification before implementation, restrict work to one decision at a time, inspect controlling and conflicting evidence, and leave missing evidence explicitly unresolved rather than selecting a plausible substitute.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Context architecture is not merely providing more files to an agent. For high-consequence or ambiguous work, teams need an evidence-to-decision artifact that identifies sources, conflicts, assumptions, and unresolved questions before generated code enters review or becomes future agent context.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: Route company and benchmark background upstream. A local ingest should preserve the downstream evidence-to-specification review pattern and explicitly label this source as practitioner experience, not a general empirical finding.
